descriptions.completion: Print completion script for shell (bash, zsh, fish)

descriptions.config: Show or update CLI tool configuration

descriptions.contextsActive: Show the active context (server, auth, scope)

descriptions.envSet: Set an environment variable (current session only)
descriptions.healthComponents: List health components and their status
descriptions.healthWatch: Live dashboard — refresh every N seconds
descriptions.login: Local OAuth helpers for remote OmniRoute installs (run on your own machine)
descriptions.loginAntigravity: Authorize Antigravity locally and print a credential blob to paste remotely
descriptions.provider: Manage provider connections (use 'providers' for the full interface)
descriptions.providersAvailable: Show available providers in the OmniRoute catalog
descriptions.providersValidate: Validate local provider configuration without calling upstream
descriptions.redisStop: Stop and remove the local Redis container
descriptions.redisStatus: Show status of the local Redis container
descriptions.runtimeCheck: Check status of native deps in runtime directory
descriptions.runtimeRepair: Reinstall native deps in runtime directory
descriptions.setupAider: Configure Aider for OmniRoute: write ~/.aider.conf.yml + print the env recipe
descriptions.setupCrush: Generate the OmniRoute openai-compat provider in ~/.config/crush/crush.json
descriptions.setupCursor: Print the steps to point Cursor at OmniRoute (chat panel; Cursor config is not file-writable)
descriptions.setupGoose: Configure Goose for OmniRoute: write ~/.config/goose/config.yaml + print the env recipe
descriptions.setupQwen: Configure Qwen Code's upstream V4 modelProviders format for OmniRoute
descriptions.tokensCreate: Create a new access token (requires admin scope)
descriptions.tokensRevoke: Revoke an access token by id or display prefix
descriptions.setupContinue: Generate ~/.continue/config.yaml (Continue / cn CLI) from the OmniRoute model catalog
descriptions.setupCline: Configure Cline for OmniRoute: write ~/.cline/data (CLI mode) + print VS Code extension settings
descriptions.setupCodex: Fetch the live model catalog from OmniRoute (local or remote VPS) and generate ~/.codex/<name>.config.toml profiles for each supported model
descriptions.setupKilo: Configure Kilo Code for OmniRoute: write ~/.local/share/kilo/auth.json (CLI) + VS Code kilocode.* settings
descriptions.setupRoo: Configure Roo Code for OmniRoute: write a Roo import JSON + autoImport pointer + print UI steps

descriptions.setupOpenCode: Install and register the bundled @omniroute/opencode-plugin with a local OpenCode install
descriptions.tokens: Manage scoped CLI access tokens (remote mode)
descriptions.trayShow: Show the tray icon when the server runs with --tray
descriptions.configure: Pick a provider and model and write a local CLI config (v1: codex)
descriptions.connect: Connect to a remote OmniRoute server and enter remote mode
descriptions.launch: Launch Claude Code pointed at OmniRoute (local or remote)
descriptions.launchCodex: Launch Codex CLI pointed at OmniRoute (local or remote VPS)

tui.helpText:
Available commands:
  /model <id>        Change active model
  /combo <name>      Change active combo
  /system <prompt>   Set system prompt
  /clear             Clear conversation history
  /save <name>       Save current session
  /load <name>       Load a saved session
  /list              List saved sessions
  /history [N]       Show last N messages (default 10)
  /export <file>     Export conversation (md/json/txt)
  /tokens            Show token usage + cost
  /file <path>       Attach file content to next message
  /temperature <t>   Adjust temperature (0-2)
  /max-tokens <n>    Adjust max tokens
  /reasoning <level> Adjust reasoning level
  /skill execute <id> '<args>'  Run a skill
  /memory search <q> Search memory
  /memory add <text> Add to memory
  /help              Show this help
  /exit, /quit       Exit REPL
